enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Turn onto right side. Adjust pillow. Breathe slowly. Turn onto back. Adjust blanket. Breathe slowly. Turn onto left side. Adjust pillow. Remain asleep.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on faucet. Wet hands. Apply soap to hands. Rub hands together. Rinse hands. Turn off faucet. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste to toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water. Spit into sink. Wipe mouth with towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out cereal box. Open cereal box. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Close milk carton. Put milk back in refrigerator. Pick up spoon. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk from bowl. Stand up. Place bowl in sink. Rinse bowl.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Button shirt. Put on pants. Zip pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Tie shoelaces. Walk to mirror. Check appearance. Brush hair. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Check phone for time. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Walk to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Clock in at workplace. Put on lab coat. Review patient charts. Walk to patient room. Wash hands. Greet patient. Say 'Hello, how are you feeling today?' Check patient's vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Record temperature. Administer medication. Update patient records. Walk to next patient room. Wash hands. Greet patient. Say 'Good morning, I'm here to check on you.' Check IV drip. Adjust IV flow rate. Walk to nurses' station. Discuss patient status with colleague. Write notes. Answer phone call. Schedule appointment.

Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay for food. Find table. Sit down. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Talk with colleague. Say 'How is your day going?' Listen to colleague. Finish eating. Stand up. Return tray. Walk out of cafeteria.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Return to work area. Review schedule. Walk to examination room. Wash hands. Prepare equipment. Greet patient. Say 'Please have a seat.' Take medical history. Perform physical exam. Draw blood sample. Label sample. Send to lab. Update records. Walk to next patient. Wash hands. Assist with procedure. Hand instruments to doctor. Clean equipment. Disinfect room. Walk to break room. Drink water. Return to desk. Write reports.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Listen to music. Check phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to home. Enter home. Close door.

Walk to kitchen. Wash hands. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Close refrigerator. Take out cutting board. Take out knife. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Serve food onto plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Place plate in sink. Rinse plate.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch news. Adjust volume. Change channel. Watch show. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Log in. Open browser. Go to website. Scroll through page. Click on link. Watch video. Type comment. Check email. Reply to email. Open game. Play game. Exit game. Shut down computer. Stand up.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Place clothes in hamper. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Apply shampoo. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to bedroom. Lie down on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media app. Scroll through feed. Like post. Open messaging app. Type message. Send message. Read reply. Open video app. Watch video. Close app. Put phone on nightstand. Turn off light. Close eyes.
Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Adjust pillow. Turn onto side. Breathe slowly. Remain asleep.
